ownership: Original identity lock and pinned directory own recovery. Reset acquires the stable trust lock before creating intent, retains both through synchronous erasure, and leaves an empty identity.reset marker on failure. Trust loads reject that marker. Identity and trust records retain their existing 8208/65624-byte bounds; temporary validation holds bounded parsed certificate/key data and makes no physical-erasure claim. Incomplete/corrupt state cannot rotate a key without explicit reset. Conditional eventual settlement requires filesystem success and previous-owner retirement.
